prompt:
Generate ONE production sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, ideally 1536x1152 pixels. Each cell has one small Chinese fantasy building object, real transparent alpha background. Grid aligns perfectly. Center each object within central 76% of its cell with 12% transparent padding on each side. No frame, no borders, no visible grid, no labels, no text, no letters, no watermark, no outside scenery. Refined hand-painted xianxia game style with crisp silhouettes, visible materials, restrained aura. Each PAIR is the SAME object's two renderings: UI inventory icon three-quarter view, then map ground sprite high-angle orthographic top-down view (NOT isometric), front points downward, occupies a single square map cell. Ground image should be simple, readable, have minimal contact shadow and no floor diamond. All 12 cells must stay separate.
